parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized that it had to reverse-engineer a fastText-like CLI by observing the binary and README only, producing a new executable without wrapping or source lookup.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent did initial probing, then split the behavior surface into eight AgentSwarm exploration topics whose deliverables were markdown notes. Implementation, quantize, dump, nn, analogies, meter, autotune, compile, and verification stayed as later parent work.
parallel.implementation: No replacement source tree, compile script, or new executable was produced. The only non-original deliverables in the artifact were notes and scratch work files from probing.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent read all eight note files and began extra RNG experiments, but did not integrate the findings into a codebase or assemble a final buildable deliverable.
parallel.verification: The run performed extensive behavioral probes through child agents and the parent, but there was no integrated test of a reimplementation because no implementation existed. The official evaluator failed at compile time.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Implementation and final verification remained pending at cancellation; the submitted artifact lacked a buildable replacement and failed with 352 tests not run.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same clean-room fastText-like reimplementation requirements and explored only by running the provided executable and reading bundled documentation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One main agent kept a local todo list covering command usage, training, formats, query commands, quantization, implementation, and verification, with no subagents or handoff boundaries.
serial.implementation: The serial run conducted many local probes and created scratch datasets and output models, but it did not create replacement source code, compile.sh, or a new executable.
serial.integration_and_delivery: There was no component integration or final assembly. The submitted artifact contained only the original workspace files and no usable reimplementation.
serial.verification: The serial run verified observed behavior through local probes and deterministic checks, but had no implementation to compile or test; the official evaluator failed at compile time.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial agent was cancelled while probing query commands; implementation, quantization, save/load, command support, and final verification remained incomplete.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run saw the clean-room benchmark requirement and the need to produce an executable with identical behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run received the same prompt and worked under the same clean-room restrictions.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference; both understood the task but neither delivered the required reimplementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent decomposed the task into eight AgentSwarm exploration topics, all with markdown-note outputs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial main agent kept one local todo list covering probes first and implementation later.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spread investigation across agents, while serial kept the reverse-engineering loop local; neither assigned an active concurrent implementation worker.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel briefs gave each child a topic and notes path, and the parent read all returned note files before deciding the next step.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had no handoff boundary; findings stayed in the same main trajectory as it continued probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a note-handoff phase but did not lose or ignore the returned information; the issue was deferring implementation until after the handoff phase.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After the swarm, the parent was still pinning down RNG behavior and kept C++ implementation as pending work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run similarly remained in probing and format parsing with implementation tasks still pending.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had richer topic-specific notes, while serial had a narrower continuous probe log; both ended before replacement source creation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All eight exploration children returned through the swarm result, and the parent read their note files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There was no child result lifecycle in serial; the single main actor continued until cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel results were returned and consumed, so there was no missing child join; the lifecycle cost was that implementation was only considered after all notes returned.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote distinct notes and scratch outputs, but no competing source components or integrated deliverable appeared in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial artifact contained only original workspace files and no generated code deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left more research artifacts in shared state, but there was no write collision or source merge; both final trees lacked a buildable implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verification was limited to behavioral probes; no submitted implementation was compiled or tested before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verification was also limited to behavioral probes without an implemented artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material acceptance difference; both official evaluations completed with compile_failed and 352 tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run used the full budget, timed out after the swarm and RNG probing, and ended on cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run also used the full budget and was cancelled while still probing commands.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent its budget on a separate eight-child investigation phase before parent implementation; serial spent its budget in a single local investigation path. Both closed before implementation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both completed official evaluations failed with compile_failed and 352 tests not run. The parallel run generated broader behavioral notes through an eight-child swarm, while the serial run performed continuous local probing, but neither created a buildable replacement codebase or executable.
parallel_contributors: Parallel children completed only investigation-note tasks; implementation remained pending after note consumption.
serial_contributors: The serial main agent remained in behavioral probing and was cancelled before creating source code.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No ordinary code-level implementation defects can be compared because neither run produced replacement source.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; process contrast only

candidates.reason: Implementation was deferred, but it was still explicitly present in the parent plan after the swarm, so the problem is not ownerless implementation.
No parallel agent produced separate implementation components that required an integration owner.
There were no complete components or source deliverables awaiting final packaging or executable placement.
The run never reached owned implementation stages whose end-to-end transition became unowned.
There was no single mandatory preflight or harness gate; the delay came from a broad investigation-first swarm.

The parent launched overlapping investigators for the behavior surface, waited for their note results, then still had implementation and verification pending and was cancelled before building a replacement executable.
candidates.realized_consequence: Implementation and verification were displaced until after the investigation phase, then cancellation left no buildable replacement artifact.
candidates.near_match_reason: The parent retained implementation in its pending todo list, so the sharper diagnosis is not absent ownership but a pseudo-concurrent investigation phase that deferred implementation.

candidates.reason: Implementation started too late, but that is already the direct consequence of the retained investigation-first episode rather than a separate capacity allocation event.
Eight children returned successfully; child count and timeout alone do not show a distinct excessive-fan-out exhaustion episode beyond Serial Investigation.
No single child was given an overbroad implementation scope or left its assigned note deliverable unfinished.
The child briefs included the clean-room restrictions, the binary location, the assigned topic, and the required notes path; no omitted known requirement made child work unusable.
The children were not building interoperating components, so there was no missing cross-agent implementation contract or incompatible component set.
The returned findings were written to notes and then read by the parent; no known finding is shown disappearing in transfer.
The notes were large, but the parent read them and formed a specific RNG follow-up; there is no direct evidence that bulk structure itself made the handoff unusable.
No child report described a superseded workspace or stale requirement that the parent then acted on.
The record does not show incompatible child reports or contracts remaining unadjudicated at an integration decision.
The parent did not make an observable whole-task completion decision; the run was cancelled while implementation was still pending.
There was no replacement child or retry attempt that lacked inherited checkpoints and repeated prior work.

Completed child notes were inspected by the parent before it chose the RNG follow-up, so no available result was ignored.
